new_categories.label: dry_cargo_quantity_measurement_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo quantity/mass measurement assurance is a delivered service-state distinct from spatial cargo distribution, liquid-tank gauging and higher-level hydrostatic analysis.

new_categories.label: measurement_path_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of a quantity-measurement path can be represented separately from the resulting quantity confidence without retaining exact method, instrument or calculation.

new_categories.label: shipboard_observation_path_confidence
new_categories.memory: A shipboard observation-based quantity path can be represented abstractly without retaining drafts, densities, hydrostatic values, corrections or survey procedure.

new_categories.label: shore_measurement_or_tally_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: A shore scale, tally or terminal measurement interface can be represented as a distinct assurance path without retaining values, device details or commercial rules.

new_categories.label: cargo_operation_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Quantity assurance can be bounded to a cargo parcel, hold set, loading/discharge operation or transfer stage without retaining exact quantities or commercial identifiers.

new_categories.label: measurement_representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that a measurement/tally path represents the intended cargo-operation scope is distinct from path availability and from the resulting quantity judgment.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_quantity_mass_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence in cargo quantity/mass can be retained without storing draft, density, scale, tally or calculated values.

new_categories.label: measurement_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement validity is distinct from measurement availability and can degrade independently without exact calibration, correction or acceptance data.

new_categories.label: independent_crosscheck_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate quantity cross-check confidence can be represented separately from the primary path without retaining reconciliation calculations or tolerances.

new_categories.label: commercial_reconciliation_not_measurement_equivalence
new_categories.memory: A downstream cargo-accounting, claim or reconciliation state is not equivalent to, and does not prove, the underlying measurement path or quantity validity.

new_categories.label: quantity_measurement_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Quantity-measurement assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to path, scope, representativeness, validity or cross-check state, while accounting uncertainty, terminal concern, claims, rework or schedule do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_quantity_assurance_restoration
new_categories.memory: Measurement-path recovery, validity verification, cross-check recovery, reconciliation confidence and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: dry_cargo_quantity_vs_liquid_tank_gauging
useful_refinements.memory: P095 liquid-cargo tank gauging/quantity measurement does not establish dry-cargo quantity/mass measurement, tally or survey assurance.

useful_refinements.label: quantity_measurement_vs_hydrostatics_orientation
useful_refinements.memory: P066 hydrostatics/stability orientation may support some shipboard quantity paths but is broader and not equivalent to the delivered dry-cargo measurement service.

useful_refinements.label: quantity_measurement_vs_distribution_trim
useful_refinements.memory: P122 cargo distribution/trim describes where cargo is arranged, not how total or scoped cargo quantity/mass assurance is established.

useful_refinements.label: measurement_result_vs_commercial_reconciliation
useful_refinements.memory: Quantity measurement confidence and later commercial reconciliation/claims confidence should remain separate states even when they interact.

duplicates.label: generic_measurement_validity_representativeness_crosscheck_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic measurement availability, representativeness, validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded dry-cargo quantity/mass measurement and tally assurance questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact drafts, densities, values, calculations, methods, acceptance/commercial rules, providers or disputes that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo quantity/mass measurement and tally assurance orientation and source-discovery output; not draft-survey, weighing, tally, calculation, cargo-accounting, claims or commercial-reconciliation guidance and not proof of any exact value, formula, tolerance, procedure, provider, dispute or current-readiness fact.
